role: Student Intern, Processes and Applications, Programmer
jd:
Req ID: 141353

Remote Position: Hybrid

Region: Americas

Country: Canada

State/Province: Ontario

City: Toronto

16 Month Internship

As a global technology leader, Celestica designs, engineers, and manufactures industry-leading products and services that drive customer success and market advancement. Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, we bring together over 33,000 employees across more than 45 sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.

With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain management and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. Working with the world’s leading technology companies across a broad range of industries, Celestica helps its customers achieve a competitive advantage. These products span key areas such as data centre technology, aerospace and defense, healthtech, and capital equipment.

Working at Celestica is more than a job. It’s about being part of something bigger and shaping the future with your work. You’ll take on exciting and challenging projects, get hands-on experience, collaborate with a global team, and learn from some of the greatest minds in the industry. And just as we aspire to imagine, develop and deliver a better future with our customers, we’re just as committed to delivering the best employee experience.

Benefits For Students Include



- Experience working for one of the largest Canadian global technology companies 
- Possibility of a student casual contract position after completion of internship 
- Possibility of a full-time position after completion of degree 
- Access to Celestica’s development programs and projects 
- Celestica's Time Off to Volunteer program – two paid days off to volunteer per year 
- Fun intern activities including celebration events and networking 
- Internal recognition programs and rewards for stellar performance 

What’s in it for you?



- Opportunity: Job experience at a large Canadian-based global company 
- Innovation: We look to our employees to implement new ideas and improve the way we do things 
- Collaboration: Students work as part of global teams, enabled by collaborative technology 
- Sustainability: We uphold strong ethics, reduce our impact on the environment and empower employees to give back to the community with two paid days off per year to volunteer 
- Development opportunities: including soft skills courses, innovation projects and mentorship 
- Networking: Strategically build your professional network to advance your career and deepen relationships across your peers and colleagues. 
- Fun: Our interns have the opportunity to participate in fun activities including intern social events, Celestica’s charitable initiatives and our Spirit Week activities 

About This Opportunity

Students for this position are currently enrolled in an Engineering or Computer Science program and are team players who possess strong analytical and interpersonal skills, have excellent software-oriented skills (programming languages and database software). Knowledge of Manufacturing, Procurement and the Electronics industry is also recommended.

The student will develop the following skills and work in the following areas:



- Programming and analytical skills
- Supply chain/commodity business practices
- Advance proficiency in various Microsoft products
- Project management experience
- Global site interaction

Preferred Skills



- Strong analytical, technical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
- Good communication and documentation skills
- Basic manufacturing system knowledge
- Excellent time management skills
- Knowledge in Microsoft Office suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
- Experience working with VBA is considered an asset

Activities



- Provide technical support and perform maintenance
- Create technical documentation and knowledge base articles
- Respond to system problems by analyzing the issue and determining the next course of action
- Provide system training to end users
- Gather and document business requirements by engaging with business partners
- May have the opportunity to develop and maintain various business processes
- Work with multi-disciplinary teams on continuous improvement initiatives as necessary to enhance processes to meet cost, quality, and delivery
- Works under close supervision and receives detailed instructions on all work assignments. Once proficiency in the tasks is achieved, interns will work autonomously and be given more complex duties. Will work directly with immediate supervisor, coworkers, and team members

Physical Demands



- Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment. 
- Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. 
- Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required 

Salary

The range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including but not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate.

The hourly wage is determined by the years of study completed and is non-negotiable as per company policy.

Hourly Wage: $23-30 CAD/hr

Additional Details

Area: Processes and Applications

Start Date: May 2027

Location: 5140 Yonge Street, Toronto, ON

Vacancies: 1

Experience: No formal experience required

Education: Enrolled in a formal internship or co-op General Engineering or Computer Science program in a recognized university. University program completing 3rd of a 4-year program or 4th of 5-year program of study and eligible for an internship program.



- As this position involves work that is subject to the Canadian Government's Controlled Goods Program (CGP), your employment offer is conditional upon the successful completion of a security assessment by Celestica and/or its authorized agents, per the Controlled Goods Regulations.

To apply, please visit www.celestica.com. Please provide a copy of your transcript with your application. Please include your student email address in your application.

Celestica is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.

Company Overview

Celestica (NYSE, TSX: CLS) enables the world’s best brands. Through our recognized customer-centric approach, we partner with leading companies in Aerospace and Defense, Communications, Enterprise, HealthTech, Industrial, Capital Equipment and Energy to deliver solutions for their most complex challenges. As a leader in design, manufacturing, hardware platform and supply chain solutions, Celestica brings global expertise and insight at every stage of product development – from drawing board to full-scale production and after-market services for products from advanced medical devices, to highly engineered aviation systems, to next-generation hardware platform solutions for the Cloud. Headquartered in Toronto, with talented teams spanning 40+ locations in 13 countries across the Americas, Europe and Asia, we imagine, develop and deliver a better future with our customers.

We use artificial intelligence tools to assist in screening and assessing applications for this role. All hiring decisions involve human review.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.

Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.
fit_why: Manufacturing/supply-chain business software; Microsoft/VBA focus, not core web stack

role: Data Infra Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2027
jd:
About Wing: 

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

About the Program: 

Join Wing's 12-week paid summer internship! This is a hybrid, in-person program based in Palo Alto, CA, with start dates in May or June. Eligible candidates must be a current student enrolled in a degree program and intend to return to the program after the completion of the summer internship.

About the Role:

Wing is looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join our Wing Data Infrastructure based in Palo Alto, CA.

The Data Infrastructure team builds the foundational systems that manage the vast data generated by our global fleet of autonomous aircraft. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain the scalable data pipelines that collect, process, and store aircraft telemetry and logs, making flight data securely accessible for analysis, machine learning, and AI. As an intern, you will jump right into this mission, taking ownership of a critical project that empowers our engineering and flight operations teams to better understand aircraft performance and debug issues in the fleet. Ultimately, your work will help provide the data backbone that is essential for scaling Wing's operations safely and efficiently.

In this role, you will:



- Take ownership of a scoped engineering project to design, develop, and test a service that addresses a real-world challenge for Wing.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with experienced software engineers, aerospace engineers, and flight operations teams to integrate diverse data sources and improve how we view our aircraft fleet.
- Gain hands-on experience optimizing batch or interactive services, learning how to build reliable and scalable data systems in a production environment.
- Work with massive, real-world datasets generated by a global fleet of delivery drones.

What You’ll Need: 



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, graduating between December 2027 and August 2028
- Demonstrated coding experience with one or more languages - C++, Java, Python, Go and/or JavaScript.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to work on challenging problems and identify potential solutions with guidance from a mentor, and work toward them with a high degree of independence
- Strong examples of previous engineering experience from prior internships or extracurricular projects

Wing is an equal opportunity employer and it is Wing's policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity. Employment at Wing is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Wing does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law.

If you have a need that requires accommodation during the interview process due to a disability or special need, please let us know by completing our Candidate Accommodations Request Form.

About the Role:

Wing is looking for a Motion Planning Software Engineering Intern to join our Pathfinder team based in Palo Alto, CA.

We are looking for Engineers with Software Engineering and Path Planning experience to contribute to the development and continuous improvement of a system that safely flies thousands of autonomous aircraft every day around the world. Developing and fielding this kind of large-scale production path planning system is a challenge that you find both humbling and exciting. You enjoy developing systems from concept through production, and you have an eye for crafting practical solutions that run reliably on real-world systems. You will work in a multidisciplinary environment with direct access to our guidance, navigation, and control engineers and backend engineers.

- Build the simulation, analysis, and testing tools required to validate your algorithms against flight logs from Wing's commercial fleet.
- Have the opportunity to see your software fly on physical aircraft during flight testing, taking algorithms from simulation to real flight dynamics.
- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, including Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC), perception, and flight software.
- Gain hands-on experience developing safety-critical robotics software deployed on a commercial autonomous drone delivery fleet operating at scale.

What You’ll Need: 



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, graduating between December 2027 and August 2028
- Strong examples of previous engineering experience through prior internships, university lab research, robotics competition teams, or technical projects.
- Academic or project experience applying algorithms to path planning, navigation, or spatial search problems.
- Programming experience in C++ or Python.
- Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
- Passion for aviation, drones, or related technologies.

Wing is looking for a Software Engineer Intern to join our Wing Execution & Topology team based in Palo Alto, CA.

The Execution & Topology team develops the core backend systems at the heart of the Wing Drone Delivery Network. Our systems generate and manage key locations in the delivery network—including Delivery Zones, Charge Zones, and Pickup Zones—connect them with feasible flight paths, allocate resources, and coordinate autonomous aircraft movements from initial request to flight execution.

As a Wing Execution & Topology Software Engineer Intern, you’ll join a passionate team building the software that powers our autonomous drone delivery service. This role offers you a chance to make a real impact on Wing's growth by expanding the feature set and reliability of our delivery network, collaborating with experienced engineers across teams, and seeing drone delivery in action at our test facilities.

In this role you will: 



- Design, develop, and test backend software solutions in C++ that directly impact how we manage our delivery network topology, allocate fleet resources, and coordinate autonomous flight operations.
- Build and enhance core backend services and APIs that manage geospatial network locations and turn requests to move aircraft or packages into safe, coordinated drone missions.
- Collaborate with engineers across Execution & Topology and partner teams to build reliable features, integrate seamlessly with existing distributed systems, and improve developer and operational workflows.
- Tackle the unique, real-world challenges of autonomous drone delivery by writing well-tested, maintainable production code that enables our network to adapt to dynamic physical environments.

What You’ll Need: 



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, graduating between December 2027 and August 2028
- Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design
- Ability to read and understand C++ (experience with C++ preferred) 
- Ability to identify challenging problems and potential solutions with guidance from a mentor, and work toward them with a high degree of independence.

About
Emergent builds autonomous coding agents that replace traditional software development by generating, testing, and deploying production applications directly from plain-language intent. Our systems run in production at global scale and are used to build millions of real applications.


Since our public launch, we've crossed $130M in Annualised Revenue and grown to over 10M users across 190+ countries, who have built 12M+ applications on Emergent. We're backed by Creaegis, Khosla Ventures, SoftBank, Lightspeed, Together, Y Combinator, Google, Claypond and Sentinel Global.


We're solving the hard part of AI-driven software creation: correctness, reliability, security, and scale in real production systems. The team is built by repeat founders, Olympiad medalists, and leaders from Google, Amazon, and Dropbox. We're hiring builders who want ownership, speed, and impact at global scale.


The Role
We're hiring a Software Engineer Intern to build and ship real production systems that serve users globally. You'll work closely with experienced engineers across infrastructure, AI/ML, and product teams, taking ownership of meaningful projects from design to production while learning the principles of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability at scale.


What You'll Do:

- Build and maintain backend services using Python and/or Go.
- Work closely with experienced engineers across infrastructure, AI/ML, and product teams.
- Contribute to real production systems that serve users globally.
- Learn and apply principles of distributed systems, scalability, reliability, and performance.
- Participate in code reviews, debugging, testing, and deployment workflows.
- Take ownership of meaningful projects from design to production.


What We're Looking For:

- Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and computer science fundamentals.
- Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, or Java.
- Hands-on experience through internships, academic projects, hackathons, or open-source contributions.
- Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn quickly.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.
- Fresh graduates and final-year students


Nice to Have:

- Exposure to cloud platforms, Docker, Kubernetes, or distributed systems.
- Experience building backend applications, APIs, or developer tools.
- Contributions to open-source projects or strong personal engineering projects.
- Interest in AI, developer infrastructure, or large-scale systems.


Why Join Us:

- Build products used by millions of users worldwide.
- Work alongside exceptional engineers and industry leaders.
- Receive mentorship while owning impactful projects from day one.
- Learn at a pace that's difficult to find anywhere else.
- Competitive compensation and significant growth opportunities.
- Help define the future of software development powered by AI.


Benefits and Perks:

- Health, dental, and vision insurance


Let's build the future of software together.
